subquestion_1_12_benchmark_suite.key_finding: No TF-IDF representation passes all 12 benchmarks at 174k. Fundamental two-mode tradeoff persists: citation-based (cited_decisions_tfidf, hybrids) pass adversarial_falsification (lang_dom ~0.57-0.60), citation_heritage (AUC 0.92-0.97), multilingual/cross_lang but fail branch_knn (~0.39), tf_metadata (~0.39), hierarchy_coherence (~0.13-0.15), legal_area_clustering (~0.003), temporal_stability (std ~0.15-0.18). Text-based (full_text_tfidf_light, regeste hybrids) pass branch_knn (~0.83-0.98), tf_metadata (~0.83-0.98), boilerplate, temporal_stability but FAIL adversarial_falsification (lang_dom ~0.998-0.999) and multilingual/cross_lang. ALL fail hierarchy_coherence (max purity 0.465 vs 0.7 threshold) and legal_area_clustering (max ~0.08 vs 0.5 threshold).

subquestion_2_citation_heritage.key_finding: Citation-based signals dominate citation_heritage recovery. cited_decisions_tfidf achieves near-perfect AUC (0.973) and recovers 48.7% of cited decisions in top-10 neighbors. Text-based representations pass AUC threshold but have near-zero nn_citation_rate — they do not encode citation structure.

critical_findings.metric_learning_breakthrough: Linear projection on center_projected achieves JP=0.6847 (33.7% relative improvement over center_projected 0.512), mahalanobis JP=0.6781; both pass BOTH adversarial gates with 18+ consecutive valid epochs (frozen evaluation harness v3 seed=42 canonical)
critical_findings.stabilized_hybrid_breakthrough: Hybrid objective (contrastive + preservation + hierarchy loss) achieves 6 consecutive valid epochs, peak at epoch 1: JP=0.6656, LangDom=0.6701
critical_findings.center_projected_64dim_validated: ONLY pre-trained representation passing BOTH adversarial gates WITH meaningful hierarchical structure (LangDom=0.531, Jurist=0.982, improvement_rate=59%, hier_adv=0.027). 768-dim version FAILS jurist pairwise (0.491) - CONFIRMED on frozen harness v3
critical_findings.cited_decisions_tfidf_validated: First unsupervised signal passing BOTH adversarial gates on FROZEN harness v3 (LangDom=0.6107, Jurist=0.6922, NMI=0.563, hier_adv=0.123). BEATS supervised metric learning on jurist pairwise (0.692 vs 0.685)
critical_findings.cited_decisions_tfidf_hybrids_validated: All 6 cited_decisions_tfidf + center_projected hybrids PASS both adversarial gates on frozen harness v3. Best for production: hybrid_cp64_0.7 (LangDom=0.6518, Jurist=0.6564) and hybrid_cp768_0.7 (LangDom=0.6477, Jurist=0.6764)
critical_findings.bge_atf_resolution_fixed: BGE/ATF citation resolution IMPROVED from 0% to 100% for 2,988 role annotations. Extracted 1,573 unique BGE + 1,104 unique ATF references from full_text of 1,573 corpus decisions. Corpus citation resolution: 31.1% (2,634/8,480)
critical_findings.citation_role_hybrids_evaluated: 15 role hybrids tested on frozen harness v3. citing/following PASS at all alphas; criticizing PASS at α=0.3,0.5; distinguishing/overruling FAIL (too sparse: 58/18 annotations). Best production role hybrids: citing_alpha0.3 (LangDom=0.7414, Jurist=0.5363), following_alpha0.3 (LangDom=0.7530, Jurist=0.5188)
critical_findings.multilingual_e5_overclustering: ft_multilingual_e5_small_pretrained passes adversarial gates (LangDom=0.488, Jurist=0.702) but OVERCLUSTERS (1 coarse -> 1000 fine, hier_adv=0.0) - needs hierarchy preservation loss
critical_findings.boilerplate_resistance_negative: Boilerplate resistance NEGATIVE for ALL representations (resistance_score ≈ -0.74 to -0.92) — confirms v6 finding that proxy measures language dominance/cross-lingual alignment failure, not procedural boilerplate
critical_findings.signal_ablation_hybrids_fail: All v5 signal ablation hybrids (legal_issues_outcomes, legal_area_tfidf, hybrid_erwaegungen_03, etc.) FAIL adversarial gates on full corpus — only cited_decisions_tfidf passes
critical_findings.holdout_validation_fixed: Data leakage in v8 holdout validation FIXED. Train-only TF-IDF/SVD fitting now validates true out-of-sample generalization. All 4 zero-shot hybrids PASS adversarial gates on holdout (LangDom ~0.51, JP ~0.53-0.59). Leakage impact minimal: LangDom +0.005, JP +0.015-0.020 vs leaky results.
critical_findings.factory_targets_missed_on_holdout: JuristPref target (>0.7) missed by all zero-shot hybrids on true holdout (best: cited_outcome_hybrid_0.7 at 0.585). Citation-independent retrieval target (15%) missed by citation signals (best: 14.05%). center_projected FAILS jurist gate on holdout (0.385).
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_confirmed_holdout: Fundamental trade-off persists on TRUE holdout: Citation-based signals (LangDom=0.51, JP=0.58, CiteIndep=14%) vs Semantic embeddings (LangDom=0.73, JP=0.39, CiteIndep=37%). Both map modes needed; do not collapse to single default.
critical_findings.language_artifacts_persist_on_holdout: Despite LangDom ~0.51 passing 0.85 threshold, language neighbor rates remain 90-93% on holdout — confirms cross-lingual alignment is the systemic challenge, not boilerplate.
critical_findings.metric_learning_cite_indep_breakthrough: Metric learning achieves 34-37% citation-independent retrieval vs 13-14% for zero-shot — 2.5x improvement, ALL PASS 15% target
critical_findings.linear_metric_best_holdout_jp: linear_metric_epoch4 achieves 0.605 JuristPref on holdout — best of all representations tested, improves over train (0.532)
critical_findings.mahalanobis_strong_holdout: mahalanobis_metric_epoch4 achieves 0.585 JP + 0.581 LangDom on holdout — balanced performance
critical_findings.hybrid_stabilized_cite_indep_best: hybrid_stabilized_epoch1 achieves 36.95% cite-indep retrieval (best overall) but fails LangDom target (0.605) and has lowest JP (0.515)
critical_findings.jurist_pref_ceiling: NO representation achieves JuristPref > 0.7 on holdout — systematic ceiling at ~0.605 (v9 pre-trained) or ~0.53 (true OOS)
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_holdout_confirmed: Metric Learning (High-Purity): JP=0.605, CiteIndep=35%, LangDom=0.58 vs Citation/Outcome (High-Advantage): JP=0.585, CiteIndep=14%, LangDom=0.51
critical_findings.oos_training_passes_adversarial: BOTH linear (JP=0.525, LD=0.607) and mahalanobis (JP=0.530, LD=0.605) PASS adversarial gates on holdout when trained ONLY on 1000 train decisions — TRUE OOS generalization confirmed
critical_findings.pre_training_leakage_quantified: v9 pre-trained JP=0.605 vs OOS JP=0.525 — +8% inflation from data leakage. This quantifies the generalization gap between leakage-contaminated and true OOS evaluation
critical_findings.cite_indep_robust_across_regimes: CiteIndep 35-37% consistent across OOS and v9 pre-trained, far exceeding 15% target and 13-14% zero-shot hybrids
critical_findings.true_oos_jp_ceiling: True OOS JuristPref ceiling is ~0.53, not ~0.60 as v9 suggested. JuristPref > 0.7 requires fundamentally new approaches (not just more training data)
critical_findings.center_projected_fails_holdout: center_projected baseline FAILS jurist gate on holdout (JP=0.385 < 0.5), confirming metric learning is necessary for legal navigation
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_oos_confirmed: Metric Learning OOS: JP=0.525, CiteIndep=37%, LD=0.61 vs Citation/Outcome: JP=0.585, CiteIndep=14%, LD=0.51
critical_findings.oos_hybrid_stabilized_passes_all_gates: REPAIRED v11 (train-set selection): OOS hybrid_stabilized (MLP + hierarchy loss, TRAIN-ONLY pairs and coarse labels) PASSES all frozen gates on clean 200-holdout — LangDom=0.6015, JuristPref=0.5350, CiteIndep=0.3640, both-pass=True. Final unblocked v10 objective COMPLETED under methodologically valid OOS discipline.
critical_findings.oos_hybrid_vs_baselines_within_noise: CLEAN OOS comparison (both train-selected, apples-to-apples): hybrid_stabilized JuristPref=0.5350 vs v10 OOS linear 0.5250 / mahalanobis 0.5300. Hybrid sits at/above the v10 baselines but the +0.005-0.010 gap is within the noise floor of the 200-decision jurist-preference proxy — treat as roughly tied, NOT a demonstrated significant OOS improvement.
critical_findings.hierarchy_loss_oos_effect_honest: CONTROLLED ABLATION (same MLP head, pairs, seed; hierarchy term zeroed) under corrected train-set selection: WITH hierarchy JuristPref=0.5350, WITHOUT hierarchy JuristPref=0.5050 — clean OOS hierarchy-loss effect = +0.030 JP. Direction positive but magnitude is smaller than the selection-biased +0.055 of the rejected run; BOTH arms pass the jurist gate cleanly, so 'load-bearing for crossing the jurist gate' is NOT supported. The +0.055 claim in the prior v11 was inflated by selection-on-holdout.
critical_findings.hierarchy_loss_ablation_other_gates_stil: Without hierarchy loss the corrected OOS MLP head still passes all gates (LangDom=0.6412<0.85, JuristPref=0.5050>0.5, CiteIndep=0.3350>0.15) — hierarchy loss is NOT required to pass the jurist gate under clean OOS; it provides a modest +0.030 JP improvement.
critical_findings.oos_positive_generalization_reproduced_f: Corrected OOS hybrid_stabilized shows positive generalization (selected on train JP=0.508 -> clean holdout JP=0.535). Small 200-decision holdout jurist-preference proxy is noisy; single-point differences of 0.005-0.030 should be treated with caution (documented limitation).
critical_findings.high_purity_product_recommendation_tempe: PRODUCT NOTE (tempered from the rejected 'decision confirmed'): hierarchy-preserving hybrid_stabilized is PRODUCTION-VIABLE under TRUE OOS (passes all clean gates) and may remain a High-Purity candidate, but there is NO clean-OOS evidence it meaningfully outperforms the simpler linear OOS model. Recommend keeping linear OOS as the High-Purity baseline default and exposing hybrid_stabilized as a candidate, deferring a hard default change until a larger-scale or jurist-preference study (jurist human study or 192k) arbitrates the choice.
critical_findings.cross_mode_combination_breakthrough: v12 EXPLORATORY: Combining citation-based + metric-learning OOS embeddings PARTIALLY BREAKS the two-mode tradeoff. Best combination linear_citation_mlp achieves JP=0.620 (vs best-individual-baseline 0.585, +0.035 improvement), LD=0.532, CiteIndep=0.346. hier_citation_mlp achieves BEST-OF-BOTH-WORLDS: JP=0.605, CiteIndep=0.432 (vs best-individual 0.364, +0.068). All 23 combinations PASS both adversarial gates. MLP-trained combinations outperform all static strategies (concat, weight, PCA, ridge). Weighted combinations show citation-signal dominance (w3070 best). CAVEAT: 200-decision holdout noisy; +0.035 JP within noise floor. EXPLORATORY tier — needs validation.
critical_findings.two_mode_tradeoff_partially_broken: v12 EXPLORATORY: The two-mode tradeoff between citation-based (good LD, moderate JP, low CiteIndep) and metric-learning (moderate LD, moderate JP, high CiteIndep) is PARTIALLY BROKEN by cross-mode combinations. linear_citation_mlp achieves JP=0.620 AND CiteIndep=0.346 (vs best-individual JP=0.585, CiteIndep=0.364). hier_citation_mlp achieves JP=0.605 AND CiteIndep=0.432 — simultaneously improving BOTH metrics over the best individual baselines. This is the first evidence that combining the two modes can extract complementary signal.
critical_findings.v13_kfold_validates_static_combinations: v13 5-FOLD CV (EXPLORATORY tier) shows cross-mode combinations improve JP. CORRECTED (Repair R1): linear_citation_concat is the ONLY combination meeting the frozen success rule (mean_delta=+0.0275, paired_delta_std=0.0164 → PASS; linear_hybrid05_concat DISCOVERED (highest JP=0.7925, best CI=0.39 among JP winners) but FAILS stability (paired_std=0.042 > 0.03). linear_hybrid05_w3070 CONSISTENT FAILURE (v13 paired_std=0.033, v14 paired_std=0.062 — both FAIL). MLP combinations confirmed UNSTABLE across v13 and v14. Two-mode tradeoff persists. All sub-questions in factory direction question COMPLETE or BLOCKED.
critical_findings.v14_independent_rerun_confirmed: v14 INDEPENDENT RE-RUN CONFIRMS v13: linear_citation_concat (equal concat ML+citation) meets frozen success rule in BOTH versions. v13: mean_delta=+0.0275, paired_std=0.0164 → PASS. v14: mean_delta=+0.0392, paired_std=0.0212 → PASS. Finding promoted from EXPLORATORY to REPRODUCED tier. All 5 folds positive in v14 (deltas: +0.004, +0.054, +0.033, +0.038, +0.067). linear_hybrid05_concat: HIGHEST mean JP (0.7925) but FAILS stability (paired_delta_std=0.042 > 0.03). w3070 CONSISTENT FAILURE (v13: 0.033, v14: 0.062). MLP combinations UNSTABLE (paired_std > 0.057). Static beats learned.
